  Ya abal fazlil abbas
  Ae alamdare karbala ghazi

  Khud sakina duayeiṅ deti hai
  Jab bhi parcham koi sajata hai
  Jo bhi parcham...
  Ae sharar naqvi shadman kaho
  Ye alam aasmaṅ banata hai
  Jo bhi parcham...

item.text:
Audited all 47 lyric lines in [jo-bhi-parcham.md](src/data/lyrics/jo-bhi-parcham.md) against the Urdu. Corrected Roman spellings, nasal endings, and name capitalization. Verified stanza and refrain alignment and preserved the Urdu body byte for byte.

Rendered the unusual source spelling `غازیل` as `Ghazil`. The intended reading remains open for editorial sign-off.
